Pituitary apoplexy. Pituitary apoplexy has been reported after endocrine stimulation testing using gonadorelin. A review1 of 14 cases found that 2 patients had received gonadorelin alone but most had also received protirelin (thyrotropin-releasing hor- mone). The onset of initial symptoms was within 2 hours and pituitary tumour haemorrhage was much more common than in- farction alone. 1.
